sources.title: Basel principles for home-host supervisory cooperation and allocation mechanisms under AMA
sources.historical_claim: On 29 November 2007, the Basel Committee published final principles for home-host supervisory cooperation and allocation mechanisms in the context of Advanced Measurement Approaches (AMA), addressing supervisory cooperation and allocation mechanisms for operational-risk capital under Basel II.
sources.bn_title: AMA-এর অধীনে হোম-হোস্ট তদারকি সহযোগিতা ও বরাদ্দ ব্যবস্থার বাসেল নীতিমালা, ২০০৭
sources.bn_historical_claim: ২৯ নভেম্বর ২০০৭ সালে Basel Committee Advanced Measurement Approaches (AMA)-এর প্রেক্ষাপটে home-host supervisory cooperation ও allocation mechanisms-এর জন্য চূড়ান্ত নীতিমালা প্রকাশ করে। এতে Basel II-এর operational-risk capital বাস্তবায়নে তদারকি সহযোগিতা ও মূলধন বরাদ্দের কাঠামো নির্ধারণ করা হয়।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS final guideline verified
sources.primary_passage: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (the Committee) is issuing principles related to two important topics in the implementation of the Advanced Measurement Approaches (AMA) for operational risk under the Basel II framework.
sources.passage_locator: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Principles for home-host supervisory cooperation and allocation mechanisms in the context of Advanced Measurement Approaches (AMA), final version, 29 November 2007, Introduction.
sources.passage_status: Passage locked — official BIS-hosted Basel Committee final guideline
sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Principles for home-host supervisory cooperation and allocation mechanisms in the context of Advanced Measurement Approaches (AMA), final version, 29 November 2007; official BIS-hosted publication.
sources.edition: Principles for home-host supervisory cooperation and allocation mechanisms in the context of Advanced Measurement Approaches (AMA), November 2007.
sources.publisher: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision / Bank for International Settlements
sources.what_passage_establishes: The passage establishes the final 2007 Basel principles addressing home-host supervisory cooperation and allocation mechanisms in implementing AMA operational-risk capital under Basel II.
sources.evidence_limits: The passage establishes issuance of the principles, not implementation or compliance by particular supervisors or banks.
scholarly_references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Principles for home-host supervisory cooperation and allocation mechanisms in the context of Advanced Measurement Approaches (AMA) (November 2007).

sources.title: Basel Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision
sources.historical_claim: On 25 September 2008, the Basel Committee published revised Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision, substantially expanding its earlier liquidity guidance in response to lessons from the financial market turmoil and setting out seventeen principles for managing and supervising liquidity risk.
sources.bn_title: তারল্য ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা ও তদারকির জন্য বাসেল নীতিমালা, ২০০৮
sources.bn_historical_claim: ২৫ সেপ্টেম্বর ২০০৮ সালে Basel Committee আর্থিক বাজারের অস্থিরতা থেকে শেখা অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে তারল্য ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা ও তদারকির জন্য সংশোধিত Principles প্রকাশ করে। এতে তারল্য ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা ও তদারকির জন্য ১৭টি নীতি নির্ধারণ করা হয়।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS final guideline verified
sources.primary_passage: In order to account for financial market developments as well as lessons learned from the turmoil, the Basel Committee has conducted a fundamental review of its 2000 Sound Practices for Managing Liquidity in Banking Organisations. Guidance has been significantly expanded in a number of key areas.
sources.passage_locator: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision, 25 September 2008, opening explanatory section on the review and expanded guidance.
sources.passage_status: Passage locked — official BIS-hosted Basel Committee final guideline
sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision, 25 September 2008; official BIS publication.
sources.edition: Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision, September 2008.
sources.publisher: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision / Bank for International Settlements
sources.what_passage_establishes: The passage establishes that the Basel Committee fundamentally reviewed its 2000 liquidity guidance in response to financial-market developments and the turmoil, substantially expanding the guidance; the document then arranges this guidance around seventeen principles.
sources.evidence_limits: The passage establishes issuance and substantive expansion of the supervisory guidance, not the implementation or effectiveness of the principles by individual banks or supervisors.
scholarly_references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management and Supervision (September 2008).

sources.title: Global financial crisis
sources.historical_claim: The 2008 financial crisis became a global financial panic after the failure of Lehman Brothers in September 2008, prompting extraordinary central-bank liquidity and monetary-policy responses.
sources.bn_title: বিশ্বব্যাপী আর্থিক সংকট
sources.bn_historical_claim: সেপ্টেম্বর ২০০৮-এ Lehman Brothers-এর পতনের পর ২০০৮ সালের আর্থিক সংকট একটি বৈশ্বিক আর্থিক আতঙ্কে রূপ নেয় এবং কেন্দ্রীয় ব্যাংকগুলোকে অস্বাভাবিক তারল্য ও মুদ্রানীতিগত ব্যবস্থা নিতে হয়।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source / official contemporary record verified
sources.notes: The previous passage source pointed to a 15 September 2009 ECB speech, while the quoted wording is from the 14 October 2008 Joint Statement by Treasury, Federal Reserve, and FDIC. The source has been corrected to the official U.S. Treasury statement. sources.title: Basel Principles for Sound Stress Testing Practices and Supervision
sources.historical_claim: On 20 May 2009, the Basel Committee issued Principles for Sound Stress Testing Practices and Supervision, drawing directly on lessons from the financial crisis and establishing expectations for the governance, design and implementation of bank stress-testing programmes.
sources.bn_title: সুস্থ স্ট্রেস টেস্টিং অনুশীলন ও তদারকির জন্য বাসেল নীতিমালা, ২০০৯
sources.bn_historical_claim: ২০ মে ২০০৯ সালে Basel Committee আর্থিক সংকট থেকে প্রাপ্ত শিক্ষার ভিত্তিতে ব্যাংকের stress-testing programme-এর governance, design ও implementation-এর জন্য Principles for Sound Stress Testing Practices and Supervision প্রকাশ করে।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS final guideline verified
sources.primary_passage: The depth and duration of the financial crisis has led many banks and supervisory authorities to question the adequacy of stress testing practices prior to and during the crisis.
sources.passage_locator: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Principles for Sound Stress Testing Practices and Supervision, 20 May 2009, Executive summary/opening discussion.
sources.passage_status: Passage locked — official BIS-hosted Basel Committee final guideline
sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Principles for Sound Stress Testing Practices and Supervision, 20 May 2009; official BIS publication.
sources.edition: Principles for Sound Stress Testing Practices and Supervision, May 2009.
sources.publisher: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision / Bank for International Settlements
sources.what_passage_establishes: The passage establishes the Basel Committee's crisis-driven review of stress-testing adequacy and the issuance of principles setting supervisory expectations for stress-testing programmes.
sources.evidence_limits: The passage establishes the Committee's assessment and issuance of principles, not the effectiveness or implementation of stress testing by individual banks.

sources.title: Basel III: A global regulatory framework for more resilient banks and banking systems
sources.historical_claim: On 16 December 2010, the Basel Committee published the Basel III rules text, setting out global regulatory standards on bank capital adequacy and liquidity, including higher and better-quality capital, a leverage-ratio backstop, capital buffers and two global liquidity standards.
sources.bn_title: Basel III: আরও স্থিতিস্থাপক ব্যাংক ও ব্যাংকিং ব্যবস্থার জন্য বৈশ্বিক নিয়ন্ত্রক কাঠামো, ২০১০
sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৬ ডিসেম্বর ২০১০ সালে Basel Committee Basel III rules text প্রকাশ করে। এতে ব্যাংকের মূলধন ও তারল্য সংক্রান্ত বৈশ্বিক মানদণ্ড, উচ্চমানের মূলধন, leverage ratio, capital buffers এবং দুটি বৈশ্বিক liquidity standard অন্তর্ভুক্ত করা হয়।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS final rules text verified
sources.primary_passage: The Basel III framework is a central element of the Basel Committee's response to the global financial crisis. It addresses a number of shortcomings in the pre-crisis regulatory framework and provides a foundation for a resilient banking system that will help avoid the build-up of systemic vulnerabilities.
sources.passage_locator: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Basel III: A global regulatory framework for more resilient banks and banking systems, December 2010, Executive summary/opening section.
sources.passage_status: Passage locked — official BIS-hosted Basel Committee rules text

sources.title: Basel framework for global systemically important banks
sources.historical_claim: On 4 November 2011, the Basel Committee issued final rules for global systemically important banks (G-SIBs), establishing an indicator-based methodology to identify G-SIBs and additional loss-absorbency requirements of 1% to 2.5% of Common Equity Tier 1 capital, with an additional 3.5% empty bucket.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ৪ নভেম্বর ২০১১ সালে Basel Committee বৈশ্বিকভাবে সিস্টেমগতভাবে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যাংক (G-SIB) চিহ্নিতকরণ এবং তাদের জন্য অতিরিক্ত loss-absorbency requirement নির্ধারণের চূড়ান্ত নিয়ম প্রকাশ করে।

sources.title: Revised Basel Core Principles for Effective Banking Supervision
sources.historical_claim: On 14 September 2012, banking supervisors endorsed the Basel Committee's revised Core Principles for Effective Banking Supervision, expanding the global supervisory standard from 25 to 29 principles and incorporating lessons from the financial crisis.
sources.bn_title: কার্যকর ব্যাংকিং তদারকির সংশোধিত বাসেল কোর প্রিন্সিপলস, ২০১২
sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৪ সেপ্টেম্বর ২০১২ সালে ব্যাংকিং তদারকি কর্তৃপক্ষগুলো Basel Committee-এর সংশোধিত Core Principles অনুমোদন করে। এতে নীতির সংখ্যা ২৫ থেকে ২৯-এ বৃদ্ধি পায় এবং আর্থিক সংকটের শিক্ষা অন্তর্ভুক্ত হয়।

sources.title: Basel Principles for Effective Risk Data Aggregation and Risk Reporting
sources.historical_claim: On 9 January 2013, the Basel Committee issued Principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting, responding to weaknesses exposed by the financial crisis and setting principles to strengthen banks' risk-data aggregation and internal risk reporting, particularly at G-SIBs.
sources.bn_title: কার্যকর ঝুঁকি-তথ্য সমন্বয় ও ঝুঁকি প্রতিবেদন বিষয়ে বাসেল নীতিমালা, ২০১৩
sources.bn_historical_claim: ৯ জানুয়ারি ২০১৩ সালে Basel Committee আর্থিক সংকটে প্রকাশিত দুর্বলতার প্রতিক্রিয়ায় কার্যকর risk-data aggregation ও risk reporting-এর জন্য নীতিমালা প্রকাশ করে, বিশেষ করে G-SIB ব্যাংকগুলোর ঝুঁকি-তথ্য সমন্বয় ও অভ্যন্তরীণ রিপোর্টিং শক্তিশালী করার লক্ষ্যে।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS final principles verified
sources.primary_passage: The financial crisis that began in 2007 revealed that many banks, including global systemically important banks (G-SIBs), were unable to aggregate risk exposures and identify concentrations fully, quickly and accurately.

sources.evidence_limits: The passage establishes the identified weakness and regulatory response, not later implementation or compliance by particular banks.
scholarly_references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting (January 2013), BCBS 239.

sources.title: Basel Standardised Approach for Measuring Counterparty Credit Risk Exposures
sources.historical_claim: On 31 March 2014, the Basel Committee published its final Standardised Approach for measuring counterparty credit risk exposures (SA-CCR), replacing the Current Exposure Method and Standardised Method and providing a comprehensive non-modelled approach for OTC derivatives, exchange-traded derivatives and long-settlement transactions.
sources.bn_title: কাউন্টারপার্টি ক্রেডিট ঝুঁকি পরিমাপের জন্য বাসেল স্ট্যান্ডার্ডাইজড অ্যাপ্রোচ, ২০১৪
sources.bn_historical_claim: ৩১ মার্চ ২০১৪ সালে Basel Committee কাউন্টারপার্টি ক্রেডিট ঝুঁকি পরিমাপের জন্য চূড়ান্ত Standardised Approach (SA-CCR) প্রকাশ করে। এটি Current Exposure Method ও Standardised Method-এর বিকল্প হিসেবে OTC derivatives, exchange-traded derivatives এবং long-settlement transactions-এর জন্য নতুন non-modelled পদ্ধতি নির্ধারণ করে।

sources.title: Basel Corporate Governance Principles for Banks
sources.historical_claim: On 8 July 2015, the Basel Committee issued revised Corporate Governance Principles for Banks, superseding its 2010 guidance and setting a framework for robust and transparent risk management and decision-making.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ৮ জুলাই ২০১৫ সালে Basel Committee ব্যাংকের জন্য সংশোধিত Corporate Governance Principles প্রকাশ করে।

sources.title: Basel TLAC Holdings Standard
sources.historical_claim: On 12 October 2016, the Basel Committee issued its final standard on the regulatory capital treatment of banks' holdings of total loss-absorbing capacity (TLAC) instruments, designed to reduce contagion risk if a global systemically important bank enters resolution.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ১২ অক্টোবর ২০১৬ সালে Basel Committee ব্যাংকের TLAC instrument holdings-এর regulatory capital treatment বিষয়ে চূড়ান্ত মানদণ্ড প্রকাশ করে। এর লক্ষ্য ছিল কোনো G-SIB resolution-এ গেলে আর্থিক ব্যবস্থায় contagion risk কমানো।

sources.title: Basel III: Finalising post-crisis reforms
sources.historical_claim: On 7 December 2017, the Basel Committee published the final Basel III post-crisis reforms, revising the regulatory framework to reduce excessive variability in risk-weighted assets, strengthen standardised approaches, constrain internal models, and complement risk-weighted capital with a finalised leverage ratio and revised capital floor.
sources.bn_title: Basel III: সংকট-পরবর্তী সংস্কার চূড়ান্তকরণ, ২০১৭
sources.bn_historical_claim: ৭ ডিসেম্বর ২০১৭ সালে Basel Committee Basel III-এর সংকট-পরবর্তী সংস্কার চূড়ান্ত করে। এতে risk-weighted assets-এর অতিরিক্ত variability কমানো, standardised approaches শক্তিশালী করা, internal models সীমিত করা এবং leverage ratio ও capital floor চূড়ান্ত করা হয়।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS final standard verified

sources.title: Basel Stress Testing Principles
sources.historical_claim: On 17 October 2018, the Basel Committee issued final Stress Testing Principles, replacing its 2009 principles and updating the supervisory framework to reflect the growing role of stress testing as a critical risk-management and supervisory tool.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৭ অক্টোবর ২০১৮ সালে Basel Committee চূড়ান্ত Stress Testing Principles প্রকাশ করে। এটি ২০০৯ সালের নীতিমালাকে প্রতিস্থাপন করে এবং stress testing-এর ক্রমবর্ধমান ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা ও তদারকি ভূমিকার প্রতিফলন ঘটায়।

sources.title: Basel Minimum Capital Requirements for Market Risk
sources.historical_claim: On 14 January 2019, the Basel Committee published the final Minimum capital requirements for market risk, replacing the 2016 framework and revising the treatment of trading-book risks through a revised standardised approach, internal models approach and related supervisory requirements.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৪ জানুয়ারি ২০১৯ সালে Basel Committee বাজার ঝুঁকির জন্য চূড়ান্ত Minimum capital requirements প্রকাশ করে। এটি ২০১৬ সালের কাঠামো প্রতিস্থাপন করে এবং trading-book risk-এর জন্য standardised approach, internal models approach ও সংশ্লিষ্ট তদারকি প্রয়োজনীয়তা সংশোধন করে।

sources.title: Basel Targeted Revisions to the Credit Valuation Adjustment Risk Framework

sources.bn_historical_claim: ৮ জুলাই ২০২০ সালে Basel Committee ক্রেডিট ভ্যালুয়েশন অ্যাডজাস্টমেন্ট (CVA) risk framework-এর লক্ষ্যভিত্তিক সংশোধন প্রকাশ করে। এটি ডিসেম্বর ২০১৭-এর সংস্করণ প্রতিস্থাপন করে এবং risk weights, নির্দিষ্ট client-cleared derivatives-এর treatment এবং standardised ও basic CVA approaches পুনঃসমন্বয় করে।

sources.title: Basel Principles for Operational Resilience
sources.historical_claim: On 31 March 2021, the Basel Committee issued Principles for operational resilience, establishing a framework to strengthen banks' ability to withstand, adapt to and recover from severe operational disruptions, alongside revised principles for operational-risk management.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ৩১ মার্চ ২০২১ সালে Basel Committee Principles for operational resilience প্রকাশ করে। এতে গুরুতর operational disruption মোকাবিলা, তার সঙ্গে মানিয়ে নেওয়া এবং পুনরুদ্ধারের জন্য ব্যাংকের সক্ষমতা শক্তিশালী করার কাঠামো নির্ধারণ করা হয়।

sources.title: Basel High-level Considerations on Proportionality
sources.historical_claim: On 7 July 2022, the Basel Committee issued high-level considerations on proportionality to support supervisory authorities in implementing proportionate domestic regulatory and supervisory frameworks without undermining financial stability or the safety of financial institutions.
sources.bn_title: ব্যাংকিং তদারকিতে proportionality বিষয়ে বাসেল উচ্চস্তরের বিবেচনা, ২০২২
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS publication verified
sources.primary_passage: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision has published high-level considerations on proportionality. The publication aims to provide practical support to supervisory authorities seeking to implement proportionality in their domestic regulatory and supervisory frameworks, in a way that does not undermine financial stability or the safety of financial institutions.

sources.what_passage_establishes: The passage establishes the issuance and purpose of the Committee's 2022 proportionality considerations and their intended application by supervisory authorities.
sources.evidence_limits: The publication is voluntary and does not modify Basel standards; the passage does not establish later implementation or effectiveness.
scholarly_references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, High-level considerations on proportionality (July 2022).
sources.bn_historical_claim: ৭ জুলাই ২০২২ সালে Basel Committee proportionality বিষয়ে উচ্চস্তরের বিবেচনা প্রকাশ করে। এর লক্ষ্য ছিল supervisory authorities-কে এমন proportionate domestic regulatory ও supervisory framework বাস্তবায়নে সহায়তা করা, যা financial stability বা financial institutions-এর safety ক্ষুণ্ন না করে।

sources.title: Basel Finalisation of Various Technical Amendments
sources.historical_claim: In 2023, the Basel Committee finalised various technical amendments to the Basel Framework after a March consultation, clarifying implementation issues and amending provisions where the existing text could not resolve them unambiguously.

sources.bn_historical_claim: ২০২৩ সালে Basel Committee Basel Framework-এর বিভিন্ন কারিগরি সংশোধন চূড়ান্ত করে। মার্চের consultation-এর পর implementation issues স্পষ্ট করা এবং বিদ্যমান standard-এর ভাষায় অস্পষ্টতা দূর করার জন্য এসব সংশোধন করা হয়।

sources.primary_passage: In March 2023 the Basel Committee issued a set of proposed technical amendments for consultation. No concerns were raised by stakeholders during the consultation period. sources.title: Revised Basel Core Principles for Effective Banking Supervision
sources.historical_claim: On 25 April 2024, banking supervisors endorsed the Basel Committee's revised Core Principles for Effective Banking Supervision, updating the global minimum standard for prudential banking supervision and making the revised text effective immediately.
sources.bn_title: কার্যকর ব্যাংকিং তদারকির সংশোধিত বাসেল কোর প্রিন্সিপলস, ২০২৪

sources.title: Review of Implementation of Margin Requirements for Non-Centrally Cleared Derivatives
sources.historical_claim: On 12 December 2025, the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and IOSCO published a joint review of the implementation of margin requirements for non-centrally cleared derivatives, concluding that the framework had been effectively implemented, identifying no material issues, and recommending continued supervisory monitoring.
sources.bn_title: Non-centrally cleared derivatives-এর margin requirements বাস্তবায়ন পর্যালোচনা, ২০২৫
sources.bn_historical_claim: ১২ ডিসেম্বর ২০২৫ সালে Basel Committee on Banking Supervision এবং IOSCO non-centrally cleared derivatives-এর margin requirements বাস্তবায়নের যৌথ পর্যালোচনা প্রকাশ করে। এতে framework কার্যকরভাবে বাস্তবায়িত হয়েছে, কোনো material issue পাওয়া যায়নি এবং অব্যাহত supervisory monitoring-এর সুপারিশ করা হয়।
sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS-IOSCO joint review verified
sources.primary_passage: The assessment found no material issues with the framework. The amount of margin exchanged for non-centrally cleared derivatives has increased materially since 2012, contributing to greater financial system resilience.
sources.passage_locator: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and International Organization of Securities Commissions, Review of the implementation of margin requirements for non-centrally cleared derivatives, December 2025, Executive summary/publication statement.
sources.passage_status: Passage locked — official BIS-hosted BCBS-IOSCO final review
sources.source_identity: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and International Organization of Securities Commissions, Review of the implementation of margin requirements for non-centrally cleared derivatives, 12 December 2025; official BIS publication.
sources.edition: December 2025 joint implementation review.
sources.publisher: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision / International Organization of Securities Commissions / Bank for International Settlements
sources.what_passage_establishes: The passage establishes the joint assessment's finding that the margin framework had no material implementation issues and that increased margin exchange contributed to financial-system resilience.
sources.evidence_limits: The passage reports the review's assessment and stated contribution; it does not independently establish causal magnitude beyond the review's conclusion.

sources.title: Basel Finalisation of Technical Amendment and Frequently Asked Questions
sources.historical_claim: On 23 March 2026, the Basel Committee finalised a technical amendment to the Basel Framework concerning the standardised approach to operational risk, incorporating stakeholder feedback from the June 2025 consultation, and also issued related FAQs on market risk.
sources.bn_title: Basel Framework-এর কারিগরি সংশোধন ও FAQ চূড়ান্তকরণ, ২০২৬

sources.verification_status: Primary-source official BIS/BCBS final standard verified
sources.primary_passage: This document sets out a final technical amendment to the Basel Framework. Technical amendments are defined as changes in standards that are not substantial in nature but that cannot be unambiguously resolved based on the current text. The amendment relates to the standardised approach to operational risk. The amendment was published for consultation in June 2025 and has been finalised with some adjustments to reflect stakeholder feedback.
